enrichment.core_claim: Consciousness is a fundamental force distorting a basal wave, with the nervous system acting as a receiver, explored through a first-person cross-sensory test.
enrichment.ask_question: What does a person typically experience while going through the N.I.F. Test?
enrichment.challenge_question: How could ordinary cross-sensory introspection distinguish a receiver model from the standard view that the brain produces experience?
